# Operations: Development

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm install` | Install the npm dependency graph |
| `npm run dev` | Start the Vite development server |
| `npm run spec:generate` | Regenerate docs/spec from the live tree |
| `npm run spec:check` | Fail when generated docs/spec drifts |
| `npm test` | Run Vitest once |
| `npm run syntax-check` | Run Node syntax checks |
| `npm run build` | Produce the Vite production bundle |

The project launcher [vepa4](../../../vepa4) provides equivalent commands where supported.
